title: Synonym: Abundant
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **ABUNDANT**.
explanation: **Abundant** means existing in large quantities — *plentiful*. *Scarce* is its opposite.

title: Antonym: Ancient
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **ANCIENT**.
explanation: **Ancient** means very old; the opposite is *modern*. The other options are near-synonyms.

title: Synonym: Brief
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **BRIEF**.
explanation: **Brief** means lasting a short time or using few words — *short*.

title: Synonym: Courage
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **COURAGE**.
explanation: **Courage** is the ability to face danger or difficulty — *bravery*.

title: Antonym: Expand
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **EXPAND**.
explanation: **Expand** means to become larger; the opposite is *contract* (become smaller).

title: Synonym: Fragile
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **FRAGILE**.
explanation: **Fragile** means easily broken — *delicate*. *Sturdy* is the opposite; *fragrant* only sounds similar.

title: Antonym: Generous
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **GENEROUS**.
explanation: **Generous** means freely giving; the opposite is *stingy* (unwilling to give or spend).

title: Synonym: Hostile
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **HOSTILE**.
explanation: **Hostile** means unfriendly or aggressive. *Hospitable* looks similar but means welcoming.

title: Antonym: Humble
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **HUMBLE**.
explanation: **Humble** means modest about one's importance; the opposite is *arrogant*.

title: Synonym: Rapid
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **RAPID**.
explanation: **Rapid** means happening quickly — *swift*.

title: Antonym: Victory
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **VICTORY**.
explanation: **Victory** is winning; its opposite is *defeat*. The others are synonyms.

title: Synonym: Vacant
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **VACANT**.
explanation: **Vacant** means not occupied — *empty*.

title: Antonym: Transparent
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **TRANSPARENT**.
explanation: **Transparent** means you can see through it; **opaque** means light cannot pass through.

title: Synonym: Diligent
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **DILIGENT**.
explanation: **Diligent** means showing steady, careful effort — *hardworking*. Being diligent is not the same as being *intelligent*.

title: Antonym: Optimistic
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **OPTIMISTIC**.
explanation: **Optimistic** means expecting good outcomes; the opposite is *pessimistic*.

title: Synonym: Adversity
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **ADVERSITY**.
explanation: **Adversity** means difficult or unlucky circumstances — *hardship*. An *adversary* (not adversity) is an opponent.

title: Antonym: Ambiguous
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **AMBIGUOUS**.
explanation: **Ambiguous** means open to more than one interpretation; the opposite is *clear*.

title: Synonym: Concise
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **CONCISE**.
explanation: **Concise** means giving information clearly in few words — *brief*. *Precise* means exact, which is different.

title: Antonym: Frugal
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **FRUGAL**.
explanation: **Frugal** means careful with money; the opposite is *extravagant* (spending too much).

title: Synonym: Prudent
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **PRUDENT**.
explanation: **Prudent** means acting with care and thought for the future — *wise*. *Rash* is the opposite.

title: Antonym: Tranquil
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **TRANQUIL**.
explanation: **Tranquil** means calm and peaceful; the opposite is *agitated*.

title: Synonym: Lucid
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **LUCID**.
explanation: **Lucid** means expressed clearly and easy to understand.

title: Antonym: Verbose
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **VERBOSE**.
explanation: **Verbose** means using more words than needed; the opposite is *concise*.

title: Synonym: Zeal
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **ZEAL**.
explanation: **Zeal** is great energy or enthusiasm for a cause. *Apathy* is the opposite.

title: Antonym: Indigenous
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **INDIGENOUS**.
explanation: **Indigenous** means originating naturally in a place (native); the opposite is *foreign*.

title: Synonym: Alleviate
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **ALLEVIATE**.
explanation: **Alleviate** means to make pain or a problem less severe — *relieve*. *Aggravate* means to make worse.

title: Antonym: Scarcity
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **SCARCITY**.
explanation: **Scarcity** means shortage; the opposite is *abundance*. *Dearth* and *lack* are synonyms.

title: One word: one who cannot read or write
statement: Choose the one word for: *One who cannot read or write*
explanation: An **illiterate** person cannot read or write. *Ignorant* means lacking knowledge in general; *illegible* describes handwriting that can't be read.

title: One word: a person who always looks on the bright side
statement: Choose the one word for: *A person who always looks on the bright side*
explanation: An **optimist** expects the best. A *pessimist* expects the worst; a *fatalist* believes events are fixed by fate.

title: One word: a place where books are kept for reading or borrowing
statement: Choose the one word for: *A place where books are kept for reading or borrowing*
explanation: A **library** holds books. A *gallery* displays art; a *granary* stores grain.

title: One word: animals that feed only on plants
statement: Choose the one word for: *Animals that feed only on plants*
explanation: **Herbivores** eat plants; *carnivores* eat meat; *omnivores* eat both.

title: One word: a speech given without preparation
statement: Choose the one word for: *A speech given without preparation*
explanation: An **extempore** speech is unprepared. A *eulogy* praises someone who has died; a *soliloquy* is a character speaking thoughts aloud alone.

title: One word: a person who knows many languages
statement: Choose the one word for: *A person who knows many languages*
explanation: A **polyglot** speaks many languages. A *philanthropist* donates to good causes; a *pedagogue* is a teacher.

title: Idiom: To beat around the bush
statement: Choose the meaning of the idiom: *“To beat around the bush”*
options: To avoid coming to the point
explanation: **Beating around the bush** means talking around a topic instead of saying the main thing directly.

title: Idiom: A piece of cake
statement: Choose the meaning of the idiom: *“A piece of cake”*
explanation: **A piece of cake** means a task that is very easy to do.

title: Synonym: Garrulous
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **GARRULOUS**.
explanation: **Garrulous** means excessively talkative, especially about trivial things.

title: Antonym: Laconic
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **LACONIC**.
explanation: **Laconic** means using very few words; its opposite is *verbose*. *Brief* and *terse* are synonyms.

title: Synonym: Obsequious
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **OBSEQUIOUS**.
explanation: **Obsequious** means too eager to please or obey — *servile*. *Obstinate* (stubborn) only sounds similar.

title: Antonym: Ebullient
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **EBULLIENT**.
explanation: **Ebullient** means cheerful and full of energy; the opposite is *subdued* (quiet, restrained).

title: Synonym: Perfidious
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **PERFIDIOUS**.
explanation: **Perfidious** means deceitful and untrustworthy — *treacherous*. *Loyal* is the opposite.

title: Synonym: Sanguine
statement: Choose the word closest in meaning to **SANGUINE**.
explanation: **Sanguine** means hopeful and confident, especially in a difficult situation — *optimistic*.

title: Antonym: Esoteric
statement: Choose the word most nearly **opposite** in meaning to **ESOTERIC**.
explanation: **Esoteric** means understood by only a small group with special knowledge; the opposite is *well-known*. The other options are synonyms.

title: One word: government by the wealthy
statement: Choose the one word for: *Government by the wealthy*
explanation: **Plutocracy** is rule by the rich. *Aristocracy* is rule by a hereditary nobility; *autocracy* by one person with absolute power.

title: One word: a remedy for all diseases or problems
statement: Choose the one word for: *A remedy for all diseases or problems*
explanation: A **panacea** is a cure-all. A *placebo* is a substance with no medical effect given for psychological benefit.

title: One word: an abnormal fear of heights
statement: Choose the one word for: *An abnormal fear of heights*
explanation: **Acrophobia** is fear of heights. *Claustrophobia*: enclosed spaces; *hydrophobia*: water; *agoraphobia*: open or crowded places.
